The pool was clean, the games room operational, rooms were clean, location excellent..:we would recommend this place to our friends.  You can tell they put a lot of their profits back into the property. Would be nice to have breakfast included.  The drain in the shower did not drain well.  Oh, and they NEED to add another plug in in the kitchen…no way yea people and coffee people should be battling for the power early in the morning.  Small things though.

Beautiful grounds and exceptionally friendly and helpful staff. A good location for meeting other travelers. The layout and Atmosphere were conducive to engaging with everyone. Breakfast was not included and was ok, with mediocre coffee.
Staff were friendly and attentive. The room was clean. We liked the game area, and the children loved the pool. Wifi was very bad. It was a very slow wifi connection that often didn't work.
The grounds and room were super clean. We also had access to a kitchen though it is meant for prep as there is no way to cook. Everything was well maintained.

Hotel is fabulous! The photos don’t do this place enough justice! Everything is perfect here the wildlife, plants, pool, staff, game, rooms and location.  This hotel is located 5 mins walk from the bars and restaurants, which keeps the noise to a minimum. Staff are super friendly and cannot do enough for you! The rooms have every little detail covered! I don’t understand how they could have any negative comments! This is super cheap for the hotel is it!

The property was beautiful.  Stunning view from our window of the volcano. Many colourful plants, a faux jungle around the walkways and a beautiful pool area.  The rooms were large, spotless and were exceptionally comfortable.  It all felt very safe and relaxing. There was a free tea/coffee kitchen which was a thoughtful touch (and the coffee was gorgeous!). The staff were very attentive and helpful with booking activities. I was also lent their sewing kit to fix a broken seam on my backpack. Not being warned that the property was 100% cash when we booked.  We didn’t bring enough on us for the stay and it created a cash management issue. 
Breakfast was also unavailable due to the (sole?) cook being away for 2 days. Not ideal when activities begin early and days are high intensity.
Beautiful setting Breakfast was not complimentary and was not worth the $7.00

Absolutely beautiful place. The bungalows are set in the most amazing gardens. Each bungalow is very well laid out, loved sitting in the veranda looking at the beautiful flowers and plants and observing the wonderful hummingbirds who constantly fly by. There is a communal kitchen with free tea and coffee but breakfast is also available which was $7 and delicious. Also has a lovely pool and jacuzzi. We had 4 nights here and I honestly do not think we could have found a nicer place to stay in La Fortuna. A special mention to Elisabeth at Reception, she was such a character and always so helpful and friendly. Nothing
This property is beautiful. The staff is wonderful. Good breakfast. Lovely rooms.

Would happily return and recommend to anyone looking for an oasis on the outskirts of the town. The gardens were beautifully maintained and we saw parrots, hummingbirds and loads of other birds each day. It's a good 2km downhill walk to the town on an uneven footpath, which is fine if you've no mobility issues.

Beautiful garden with spacious Bungalows. Ours also had a big terrace with rocking chairs. Bathroom is quite big and they also provide extra blankets in case it gets cold during the night. Its at the main street but you can’t hear the traffic at all once the gate closes behind you.

La Roca Negra is like staying in paradise! The wildlife is amazing, particularly the birds. I saw dozens of species, just walking around, including many humming birds, tanegers, and a white hawk. I also spotted a family of agouti. When the weather clears there is also a view of the volcano. Not much not to like.

Location was excellent… peaceful& quiet respite between adventures… optional breakfast was good and inexpensive… Towels & some blankets had a musty odor… Freshening up laundry would improve the experience

We loved it! The hotel was super beautiful, clean, and well-organized. The variety of board games was great because we had so much fun, as well as with the ping-pong table and foosball they have. The size of the room was perfect too. We had an amazing vacation! We requested that our room be cleaned, but unfortunately, when we returned from our tour, it was still not tidy. :(

Lovely, modern large room and bathroom. Beautiful tropical gardens, great pool with hot tub, plus fun games room. Helpful friendly staff, near lots of restaurants. We didn’t have a car, but it was very easy and to get an Uber and lots of excursions/attractions will pick up up. It’s a little out of town, although there are restaurants locally. It meant it was a very relaxing place to stay though - central La Fortuna was very busy.
Jacuzzi Not a lot of guests seemed to be social and actually use any of the cool facilities like the pool and game room. Weird.

The room and grounds were very beautiful. This exceeded our expectations. The location was also fantastic. The cost was 13% higher than the booking.com reservation confirmation. Additionally, the property only accepted cash payment which was not expected and a minor inconvenience.
Beautiful grounds. Modern and comfortable.
The host is very nice. The environment is very family friendly! The breakfast is good! Kids love it!

The breakfast, the view, the gardens, and the staff.  They were all lovely. The dehumidifier wasn't strong enough and the filter needed to be cleaned as it was blinking a red light that was very visible as we tried to sleep.

Absolutely amazing place. This was the best accomodation we had in Costa Rica. Nice, clean room surrounded by beautiful garden. The garden is full of beautiful, colourful flowers, bushes, trees and the peacocks complement it all perfectly. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Love it, love it, love it here.

Staff was very friendly. Our room was clean and we loved the hammock on the porch looking at the volcano. Close to food, you could walk or drive to another little section further down. Was in a good location!
The gardens and view are beautiful.

Well located hotel with very clean rooms, we stayed in two rooms and most days ordered the breakfast which I thought good value for money in such a tourist town.  Nice pool, and great to have the game room on rainy days. Also front desk staff able to book some activities at discounted rates. Prepare to pay cash for your stay. Could be noisy from semi trucks braking outside  the main road but this was a common thing at all our hotels as trucks have no alternate routes.
Staff like Eugenia were caring and helpful. Personalized service. Beautiful amazing flowers in the garden and clean. Pillows were very comfortable Breakfast was ordinary

The room was spacious and beautiful; the landscaping and flowers were fantastic; the patio was the best! We sat outside and watched the many birds and other critters that visited. We loved being in the cabins furthest away. Breakfasts were awesome; all the staff and especially Elizabeth and Eugenie were so helpful, gracious and enjoyable to be around.

Breakfast was very reasonably priced and tasty. The resort is beautiful. Cabins set amongst lovely plants and flowers. Lovely trail around the grounds. Lots of wildlife dog and two cats about. Two tricking chairs outside front with view of volcano La Fortuna road is very busy and noisy. Busier than the M25! Quite noisy at times
Beautiful property. Exceptionally clean. Pleasant and helpful staff.  Would recommend 100%
They accommodate our request for early checking. Great location

Loved the porch sitting area, enjoyed the peaceful setting.  Lots of birds. Walking distance to restaurants, grocery store. Pool table, ping pong table, etc  provided downtime entertainment.  Short drive to many tours, site seeing activities.
Clean, perfect location and lovely hosts. Breakfast was super too!

Roca Negra is beautiful! The staff is so friendly as our stay was extremely comfortable! Highly recommend for families especially. Breakfast was very good and reasonably priced. We loved our stay! The roosters start crowing very early in the morning so earplugs are recommended if you are not an early riser.

We were treated very nicely. We got tipps for activities, what to do.
The room was very nice, within the garden with many plants and flowers where you could see quite a few birds. The view of the volcano was nice, when it wasn't raining too hard.
There wasn't a breakfast option during our stay, but there were possibilities of getting breakfast - and also dinner - nearby, a few minutes by foot..
Friendly staff. Very clean and well maintained. Delicious fresh breakfast. And an easy walk to shops and restaurants in town.

loved the pool, the accommodations, the breakfast, the walkways to the rooms with so many plants and birds along each side. it was very well situated for everything we needed and everywhere we wanted to go.

The living room outside with open 24 hours. Eugenia was an enthusiastic and very helpful host. We enjoyed the nice hot bubble tub late in the evening. The room where big and very comfortable with a nice porch to watch all the the birds in the garden. Great place!

Great location close to loads of restaurants and activity centres. 
Set in beautiful, lush surroundings.

Gorgeous grounds with lots of little touches to make the place a wonderful hangout. We loved the reading and games books by the pool, the hot tub, and the plentiful garden work that brought in so much wildlife. I wish there was a sidewalk outside! It's on a pretty busy road. There are restaurants, a corner store, a laundry, and a few art galleries just minutes away by foot - but when it's muddy it can be pretty unpleasant trekking through the grass and unsafe walking on the road. This is of course not the property's fault.
Everything was perfect!

A very warm welcome, thank you Elisabeth! Everybody was very nice. A paradise big garden with the view of animals and lots of different birds, beautiful flowers and trees and a walking trail to go around . We enjoyed a nice pool an jacuzzi. We liked our room with comfy beds and a nice terrace with views. We would like to come again! We highly recommend!
Lovely swimming pool and we also enjoyed the games room playing table tennis, table football and pool.
Nothing to complain about.

The hotel was really nice and good value for money but we didn't get chance to use the swimming pool unfortunately. The staff were really great and useful, it's a 15-20 walk into town which is fine in the day but we got taxis back.

Nice hotel in lovely garden. Staff was nice and helpful. Rooms are clean. Lovely little pool. Expensive for what you get. Breakfast is expensive. Rooms are clean, but a bit dated. The hotel is just next to a busy road with a lot of traffic. There are not enough sunbeds near the pool.
Very, nice friendly staff, swimming pool and jacuzzi.
Lush, well maintained landscaping

The environment, with small houses disseminated among a :luxuriant tropical vegetation and the common places for having a coffee or playing, and a friendly staff Less rain but not in the hands of the hotel
Very quiet and comfortable bed No, breakfast was offered while we were there since I think they wasn’t enough staff

I LOVE THIS HOTEL! Waking up every morning and seeing the volcano just made my birthday trip even more special. I spent hours in the hammock just looking at the birds around me and the volcano! The pool was a great size and the hot tub was an added bonus. It is near all the tourist sites and lots of restaurants nearby. The tea and coffee facilities were great and the staff were so helpful and left me a little surprise in my room for my birthday. I would go back to this hotel in a heartbeat!
The beauty of it, and all the greenery also only amenities Nothing
Very friendly and helpful stuff. Great accommodation with lovely view and a being pool. The breakfast was just a bit basic for the price
Proximity to attractions and restaurants No dislikes
This place was absolutely wonderful. We saw hummingbirds from our porch every morning, with beautiful volcano views. I was sad to leave.

Everything about this place was exactly what they said it would be and more . I will recommend this place to my friends and family .it was worth it and I can’t wait to go back. Thank you for a great experience. There was nothing wrong with this place I love it and can’t wait to go back

Close to La Fortuna and Arenal; my own bungalow with terrace overlooking the volcano and with a small flower garden. Very friendly staff.
Accepts paypal. Room is smaller than advertised. They probably counted bath and terrace also. Whirlpool will be heated on demand. Does not accept credit cards.

Behind the entrance Gate you feel like you've entered a hobby farm..adorable cabins surrounded by beautiful flora. Chickens, ducks, geese roam around. Very private and great view if the volcano. Walking paths. Everything was good.

The tea/coffee area were great! And I loved the game area for kids. This was so helpful when it was raining! Breakfast was great as well. Sleeping would have been better with a screen on the window, so we could keep the windows open instead of using the AC, since it was a really nice temperature outside.

Cleanness and very friendly and helpful staff.
They treated me like a family.
Made all my tours and shuttle arrangements back to the capital, since I do not speak Spanish I didn’t feel like I am in foreign country. I wish I had a coffee machine in the room for my morning coffee.

I liked the area!  Nice cabins. Not all cabins were updated.  We paid more for “upgraded” room that was in need of renovation!! It wasn’t clean so we complained and they switched out for us.  I thought the front desk staff were very unfriendly. Especially Kristin.  She was very unfriendly!!
We enjoyed the friendly welcome and the beautiful garden!
The property is gorgeous. It is big and have a lot of well maintained little trails It is close to the road so it gets a little noisy during the day.
Alles was op en top in orde !

Bedrooms were clean, gorgeous and spacious. Rooms are situated in lush green areas that make the stay feel authentic and enjoyable.
Common areas included a lovely pool and games room that were very fun to use. /
Great environment, beautiful view, pool with jacuzzi, lovely personnel X
Wonderful garden, very wide spread.
The rooms were very comfortable.  The location was great.  The host communicated very well. I would prefer more hooks or hanging rods for wet towels and bathing suits

Phantastic view to the volcano, superbe garden with lots of humming birds. Spacious room. Excellent, wonderful staff. Great jacuzzi, nice pool. Billard, ping pong. All very well maintained. Good quality of matraces. Deco a bit sterile. One can hear the cars at the road. No coffee/tea in the room.

Roca Negra Del Arenal was a true revelation and exceeded all of our expectations. Each room is a little private bungalow and ours had a very large comfy bed as well as a hammock outside with a view towards the volcano. The property has a lovely pool area and for a small extra fee you can enjoy a delicious breakfast. Special thanks to Elizabeth and Dunya who looked after us and made our stay even better Nothing
This was an amazing place, far exceeded my expectations, the staff was amazing and very accommodating! Absolutely nothing, everything was excellent!
Beautiful setting. Clean and comfortable.
Beautiful scenery and pool area

The staff members at the reception desk went above and beyond to help us. We loved watching the diverse birds found in the garden around our room and the property. The air conditioning and pool were both great. We loved the location because this area just outside of La Fortuna is quieter. It's easy to walk to a few restaurants and shops, and also easy to access hiking and hot springs from here. We had a great view of the volcano right from the door of our room. The room was a bit small, and the roof leaked a little bit in two spots during torrential rain.

lush, tropical grounds with pathways to explore, staff was so friendly and helpful, very clean rooms, awesome front porch with amazing view of volcano.   felt very safe, pool area was very nice, and enjoyed a nice breakfast there. location was great near lots of restaurants and shops. would definitely stay here again. we loved the property
The grounds were beautiful with a spectacular view of the volcano. Staff were very helpful.

The view of the volcano from our porch was amazing. The room was clean and comfortable. We did not use the pool but the ping pong and pool table were fun. The staff was friendly but their English was limited.

Roca Negra is fabulous! The location is very convenient (just opposite there is a great soda and 5 mins walking further you find the Red Frog resto/soda which is also amazing).
The houses are very comfortable, clean and the facilities are great - pool, billiard, mini football-table, etc. 
The breakfast is outsourced and for 7$ you really have a great food. After coming from Tortuguero NP, we were very happy arriving here. 
And the people at the property were very, very helpful and friendly! Not the case
We loved being able to walk around the property easily. Loved the beautiful grounds.  My husband loved the breakfast! Loved it all!

Breakfast was fantastic and felt very authentic for a great price. The location was perfect as we were interested in visiting the Arenal National park, Mistico Park, La Fortuna Waterfall, and Sloth Tour exhibit. Additionally we were able to walk to restaurants close by without worry. The gate made us feel very safe after hours. The staff was incredibly friendly especially the front desk staff who answered all our questions and even saved me with an umbrella when I got caught in heavy rain! They really made us feel so well taken care of! When the fog would lessen we had the best view of La Fortuna from the rocking chairs just outside of our room. We would absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in the Arenal area.

Great location. Friendly staff! Elizabeth and Ogenia (spelling?) were the receptionists during our stay and they were extremely helpful. The ladies cooking the breakfast were also wonderful. We enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend. It seems to be a family run hotel and they made sure guests were treated well. The staff helped us organize tours while we stayed and made our stay very welcoming and relaxing. A true Pura Vida vibe. There is a pool, hot tub, game room, and beautiful garden grounds. Also, if you are looking for some great food nearby, check out Red Frog Coffee Roasters. We loved their Costa Rican food for breakfast, lunch, and dinner as well as their natural fruit drinks and went multiple times. The road noise was a little loud, but that is out of the control of the hotel.

The room with garden views are wonderful to wake up to. The property is very well maintained with a trail through an amazing garden. The swimming pool and jacuzzi are a nice way to end the day. The location is also good to walk down to local restaurants away from the busy town.
Awesome hotel with a pool and jacuzzi and view of the volcano! Rooms are great too!

Located in beautiful garden
Nice pool and jacuzzi
Leisure activities
Nice view on Arenal Breakfast can be improvef
We had a great few days at Roca Negra. Staff were very friendly and accommodating. The property has really nice vibes. We liked everything.
Kindness and service during the stay. Location and surrounding gardens. The pool area. Breakfast at the property.
Beautiful property. Had security gates. Views of the volcano. Private, individual casitas. Staff were helpful. Wish coffee was available so that I could enjoy the patio.
Great location. Beautiful gardens that were around your rooms that made you feel in the jungle. Staff was very friendly and breakfast was very good.

It is a very beautiful hotel at Arenal vulcano with an amazing garden (we saw a lot of hummingbirds) and with a super view of the volcano. The pool is very clean and enjoyable, and there is a caffee and tea corner too. The owner is very friendly and helpful. The hotel is very quiet and calm. There is a lot of good restaurants near the accomodation. -
Beautiful views, very good looking property, secure, and friendly staff. Had an tropical house feel. Bed was a bit soft, Breakfast had limited veg options and room safe looked old and unreliable.

The planting of the grounds was stunning, it felt like you were in a jungle and the view from the patio of the volcano was fantastic especially enjoyed whilst chilling in the hammock. The pool was ideal, there was also a games area for table tennis, pool table and a table football. The staff were super friendly and gave us good advice about what to do and how to get there. Location is a little out of the main area which suits us but taxi/uber is easy to take you around. Thank you for having us! Not a major issue, especially as they do pre warn you, but you can only pay in cash.
Location and rooms. Lovely staff -
A smaller family style hotel with really cozy bungalows. Our did have a view on Arenal volcano. Beautiful garden, cozy walkways through the property, very friendly staff. Highly recommend!
Friendly staff No toucans!

Beautiful gardens, full of hummingbirds and butterflies. The view from our room was spectacular, of the Arenal volcano. The staff were friendly and helpful. Our room was large, and it was clean and comfortable. There was also a games area and we enjoyed playing pool.
The location, scenery, people, and breakfast were wonderful

Pool and jacuzzi awesome. Game room, outdoor lounge, on-site breakfast option and bungalow porch and hammock awesome. Staff helpful and welcoming. Gardens and grounds gorgeous. On-site animals including chickens sweet. Lighting in the room itself -overhead very bright, no way to tone down. Bedside lamp too dim to be useful, bathroom lighting dim. Those are minor issues only.
Pool was clean and well maintained.  The breakfast was very nicely prepared.
Beautiful grounds….paths that went on for ages and were so fun to explore

Beautiful grounds and view! Lovely gardens and walking trails, many sitting areas, great view of Arenal. On the edge of town, so easy to walk to restaurants, etc yet away from the more crowded areas. We spent hours birdwatching from our front porch or common areas over the 4 night stay. Chickens, turkeys, ducks, cat, dogs made it feel homey. Gorgeous On-site breakfast was convenient and easy, but average.

Staff was friendly and helpful. The breakfast was simple but affordable and delicious. I couldn’t get over how fabulous the view of the volcano was from each front porch of units. The grounds were beautiful snd well-kept. Loved the friendly cats and chickens on the property. Would definitely stay again. They just need coffee makers in the rooms :)
Amazing my property. With an amazing view!

This hotel exceeded my expectations. The pool area is beautiful, and the breakfast was a highlight of the stay. I recommend booking excursions through the hotel as well, specifically the Baldi Hot Springs. Great location - we brought a car, but were able to walk done to a Soda for dinner. I would stay again and recommend for others! One thing that is good to know is that they only take cash for payment.

The rooms were very nice and clean, with a mini fridge, good places for storage and very comfortable beds. The pool was a perfect temperature and a great place to relax. The grounds are well maintained and had a beautiful maze of walking paths for wandering. Elizabeth is funny and very informative, willing to help with anything.

Beautiful setting
Clean
Friendly staff 
Bungalows were clean and comfortable

Breakfast was excellent with several options offered.  It included, fruit, coffee and juice.  Excellent deal for $7.  Pool was nice and provided a place to relax on the chairs and in the water.  Enjoyed the game room options. Nothing.
The gardens are absolutely stunning and hotel has great view of the volcano. Very secure and lovely nature sounds in the evenings
Very private, great location.
Great outdoor area, super friendly staff, beautiful location
Beautiful landscaping, enjoyed the small trails and the gorgeous view of Arenal from our porch.

The best hotel we’ve been in Costa Rica!
Full of nature around and with a breathtaking volcano’s view, this place made our experience in La Fortuna even more amazing. 
Everything was very clean and spacious, with a great balcony facing the gardens and the volcano. 
The staff is super sweet and helpful, always smiling and willing to help.

We thought the service was great! Great location to the area, Great food, Great accommodation's! We loved the wildlife walking/free roaming the property and what a view of the volcano! I think maybe, maybe the only thing was the door to the bathroom was loud and squeaky...nor was the bathroom air conditioned....but really didn't prevent us from enjoying the location.
Setting was in tended gardens which attracted many different birds as well as a sloth to discover. Mattress  was a bit worn with depressions
Great property for the time in La Fortuna. Located close to everything in the area. Property exceeded my expectations. The pictures online do not do it justice.

Loved the location. The hotel has a beautiful garden and trails and rooms  are big and nice. Every room has a nice big bathroom and shower.  The breakfast was tasty and not expensive.  The owner and staff are friendly and helpful. Liked everything
Very friendly staff, beautiful property and amazing facilities.

Amazing views, location, and facilites. Breakfast for additional charge was a good value and tasty. The staff was kind and helpful. We had really great time here and wish all other hotels we stay at would be this good. If you are lucky and get neighbours that lack manner and make noise then its not so easy to sleep.

The game room was the best I have ever seen at hotel. Shuffleboard, pool, foosball and ping pong. We were traveling with an 11 year old who was entertained for hours. The pool and hot tub were lovely. The staff were funny, nice and accomodating.
Comfortable room, decent breakfast, good location. Nice gardens.

Great hotel on the edge of La Fortuna. Modern, clean and spacious rooms with a lovely terrace and view of the volcano. The gardens are beautiful with birds all around. There was a convenient parking space outside the room. Pool area was nice too.
I liked the room fridge and there is a good selection of places to eat and shop on the doorstep. No coffee making facilities but there are local places to grab a takeout.
Property was lovely and Elizabeth was amazing. Location is perfect.
The view, the comfort and size of the room, the pool, the location close to La Fortuna and its restaurants. Bonus: the hummingbirds flying around the garden Everything was up to our expectations
Close to town center, but felt like we were secluded!! Very clean and the view of Arenal volcano from our room was amazing! There was nothing bad!

The property and staff were amazing!  Very friendly people working there and very helpful too! The location was great to lots of activities in the area and in nearby La Fortuna! Great relaxing pool for relaxing in the heat of the afternoon! We truly enjoyed our stay here but one suggestion would be to add ceiling fans in the rooms and even out on the front porches of the bungalows for extra comfort in the heat. Especially if/when the power goes out occasionally.
The staff was helpful, comprehensive and friendly. Location. Gated (I felt safer). Would have loved to buy a beer or soda after a long day. But honestly it was lovely.
Food and coffee and service were exceptional. Location without view.
The grounds were beautiful. So many different flowers. The a/c was inadequate to cool the unnecessarily large room.

The staff were very friendly & helpful with arranging transportation & scheduling day tours. I really enjoyed the healthy breakfasts. The room walls are thin enough to hear the next door people’s voices & alarms
Location was great. Everything was convenient to get to. Bathrooms
The garden is beautiful and the room is nice I prefer buffet breakfast which is not the case here
This is an amazing place! Love its garden and the view of volcano right from the chairs in front of our room.

It was beautiful and perfect. Everything you would want from a boutique hotel in Costa Rica. Very comfortable beds, awesome shower, beautiful scenery. Delicious breakfast for very reasonable price. Couldn’t have been better! Close to everything! Thank you!!

The room and bathroom were very spacious and very clean. The patio with the view on the arenal volcano is really nice to chill. The gardens on the property are very beautiful and you can see different animals too. The swimming pool was a nice bonus.
Clean and quiet rooms, lush  landscape, nice pool. Kids really enjoyed the game area with pool and ping pong.

We loved our stay here. Every apartment has a pretty little garden with seating and a hammock. We loved watching the hummingbirds feed on the flower nectar. The property also has a mini farm going on - expect chickens and geese to wander by and cockerels battling it out every morning to be the loudest alarm! The pool area is very nice and there’s a mini restaurant for breakfast (cash payment in dollars only). Eugenia is a great host, very dry sense of humour! A great little with a lovely, authentic charm. Highly recommend! Nothing
room, breakfast, staff, facilities, location

This property is so much more than the photos show. The gardens are beautiful, the staff so lovely , helpful and friendly. The rooms are lovely with great outside seating and hammocks and the pool area is great too.
Beautiful property with lush gardens.

Beautiful grounds, friendly and helpful staff, yummy breakfast, terrific view of Arenal, very affordable. We loved our stay at this peaceful hotel! I guess the pool isn't very impressive, but there are plenty of hot springs around.

Surrounded by beautiful tropical
Plants and a view of Volcan Arenal. Also better to be a little out of La Fortuna itself .  Lots of restaurants around in easy walking distance . Facilities for making tea coffee and eating your own food . Could hear the sound of the road when sitting around the lovely pool which was very busy . Also you have to pay in cash which I wasn’t aware of needs to be more obvious on the info .
Everything was brilliant. We enjoyed our stay and had a lot of fun. Thanks Elisabeth ;)

Loved the grounds, front porch with hammock and really nice staff! A bonus was the sloth on the property! Needing to pay in cash. We didn’t want to bring that much cash with us for safety and it caused some stress needing to go to the bank to get cash. Loved everything else!

Tranquil setting at the quieter end of town but still close enough to walk to restaurants and shops. Beautiful gardens and pool area. Detached villas nicely decorated and very spacious. Each with their own private patio area.
Super friendly and helpful staff too!! Just 2 little things but honestly would still give this little gem of a place 5 ⭐️. Air con units were a little noisy at night and towels were quite rough
Beautiful property and cabins. Great view of Arenal on a clear day. Friendly staff. Near restaurants, but quiet.
The staff were AMAZING!!! The lady who checked us in was just the best, helped us with everything, she didn’t stop working. Views of the volcano from our rooms terrace. Our best stay in CR

The staff makes the whole experience wholly amazing!
Very clean accommodations and the possibility to borrow forks and plates to cook something fast in your room. Breakfast is also very affordable! The location is only 8 mins from the Arenal National Park and that's an amazing hike to do while in the vicinity. Read the fine prints for payment, they accept PayPal and cash. They are very accommodating if you need to go to the bank to withdraw. Avoid a surprise 😉 they accept USD and CRC.
Eugenia was Amazing 👏 That I had to leave!

The property is lovely and spotless. Elizabeth at the front desk is delightful and made a tired mama like me laugh out loud several times during all of our interactions. The casita was large and the a/c was nice and strong. The view of the volcano was perfect. We had parking right outside our door.

exceptional in every sense. 
the cottages and gardens are gorgeous, the amenities excellent and all the staff so very friendly. 

ideally located within easy walking of the local restaurants. nothing, would have given more than 10 if possible

Gorgeous!  The grounds, our villa, the beds (very comfy), spacious and beautiful bathroom, the pool, the view, the staff (JaHavea the best), our porch was the bomb!  
It was all amazing!!!  Clean and exceptionally well kept.
Perfect location.  Easy to walk to eat & get snacks.  Uber picks you up at gate.  Quick ride to springs, bridges, downtown, it’s all there.
Front desk staff is very helpful!!!! Thank you. Should have reserved more nights here.
It is a beautiful property with fabulous friendly staff.
Lovely vibe.. A little cramped bathroom, but perfectly adequate. Only accepting cash
Lovely hotel with great views of the volcano. Brilliant facilities and staff couldn't be better. Would choose this hotel again. Noise from the road during the day

The Elisabeth who worked at the reception was super funny, and really helpful and with the positive energy all the time. The hotel without her would not be the same. Beautiful garden, view of Arenal, birds, pool and games for free-table tennis, futball and billard. We also had jacuzzi-it was great, would stay again. Everything was great

Elizabeth at Reception is a wonder! So helpful, fun & a great problem solver 
Really kind people in a nice setting We didn't have a car & its a bit of a walk on the highway to town...but users & shuttles available
Easy to reach after landing at SanJose airport in beautiful setting. Sadly restaurant closed at 8.30pm so were to late for supper as we arrived at 8.45pm.
The staff and breakfast was wonderful. Clean and comfortable rooms. Great views and the ambiance was serene jungle. Walking distance to restaurants also! Cash only

Really helpful staff. Wonderful grounds, fantastic breakfast. 
Highly recommend, Blow the cloud off the top of the volcano!
Great location-not so crowded surroundings, but close to shops and restaurants. Beautiful garden, nice view to Arenal Volcano and gorgeous host Alicia, who was nice and helpful arranging us tours.

What a gorgeous gem of a place. This was our favorite place we stayed out of four locations around Costa Rica. Stunning, lush landscaped grounds, beautiful big porch to enjoy the nature and birds flying around, perfect location on main road in close proximity to La Fortuna and all its attractions and amenities. Our little villa was private, spacious, spotlessly clean, and had a beautiful, huge bathroom. I would stay here again in a heartbeat! Nothing, it was perfect!
Quiet separate bungalow with beautiful gardens surrounding the private patio

The hotel really brought the rainforest to you. The greenery was well kept, the common areas were clean and relaxing, the beds were comfy, the staff were amazing! And there was plenty to do at the hotel if you didn’t want to venture out. It was perfect distance from downtown Fortuna and there were plenty of restaurants within a few minutes walk. Plus the breakfast was delicious!
The atmosphere of the hotel. The garden setting and the care put into it showed throughout the hotel. Some of the rooms are close to the main road and it was noisy at times due to the passing by cars

Lovely staff. Grounds are amazing and so attract lots of amazing birds. Amazing views of volcano. A few minutes to local restaurants with La Fortuna 25 minute walk or a few minutes in a cheap taxi/Uber.
It’s an oasis of lush jungle like beauty so close to a bustling downtown!!

We stayed at Roca Negra Hotel just outside La Fortuna for four nights. In a nutshell, this hotel is a gem and I highly recommend it! Each room or cabana has a private patio or deck and it is set amid a lush tropical garden with pathways leading to the pool and breakfast area. A few kilometers outside of La Fortuna it is just across the road from several restaurants. The friendly hospitality from our hostess Elizabeth and staff were exceptional.

Very well kept property. A lot of beautiful flowers. Rooms are clean and good equipped (AC, fridge,..)
Staff was exceptional, breakfast was good value and the pool is just beautiful. I liked the view we had at Arenal.

Great location, rooms are fairly simple but spotless, and we loved the private terrace with hammock, comfortable chairs, view of the garden and volcano.
Pool area also lovely, and there is a games room
Staff are a joy - such a friendly welcome and good advice on the local area.
Highly recommended
Location, great vibe. Maybe coffee in the room would have been good
A little garden paradise! We loved the private detached rooms, the friendly staff, great location, and the variety of plants. A tiny thing: the towels were a bit rough.

Everything was great! The vibe was amazing, they definitely put an extra effort into making your experience enjoyable! Which is very much appreciated. Price was a little bit overboard to be honest. After getting the final bill.
Massive bed, hammock on the patio, great breakfast at a small additional cost, friendly staff and a beautiful pool

We liked everything! The property was amazing. Beautiful gardens. Rooms were spacious clean. All the gals at the front desk and the owner helped us so much with scheduling different tours and anything else we needed! Highly recommend this gorgeous paradise. Great location! Nothing!
Superb location, within walking distance of many restaurants and eateries. Gardens are fabulous and full of wildlife. Pool facilities are clean and spacious. Nothing.

The location is on the edge(?) of Fortuna so there are several good restaurants in short walking distance. It is convenient to the hot springs area and easy for tour pickups. That said the highway is noisy. The grounds are very beautiful, with paths that thread through and make the space seem larger. The rooms are very private, each has its own entrance, very clean, large, comfortable beds. Terraces with comfortable seating.The staff es muy amable, very responsive and helpful. The noisy highway, tricky to cross. It's a tradeoff, convenience or seclusion.
Privacy with own little house on property Could hear cars and traffic from property

The gardens, patios, and pool area were beautiful with birds everywhere!  We enjoyed the Tipico breakfast by the pool in the morning!  A delightful little hotel where we would definitely ❤️ to stay again! The internet in the room was hard to connect to, but the connection on the patio and beside the pool was good.
Beautiful property Loved everything

Pool, hot tub, communal area, breakfast - we loved the cooks/ hostess in the breakfast area - tip lots! front desk ladies were the best- we had lost our luggage and they helped us try and find it. Great property. Peacock on site was fun. No
Room:  They need to put coffee pots in the rooms! Coffee and breakfast…none.
The traditional Costa Rican breakfast was not only beautifully presented, but also delicious.
Beautiful property with gardens full of flowers and bird watching! The stand alone cabins are great. Love the chairs and hammock on porches. Close to walk to restaurants (less than 1 mile.)

We had a very large comfortable room with a front patio with rockers and a hammock facing Arenal. Our room was far off the somewhat loud main road and therefore quiet. The pool and grounds were nicely maintained. Convenient location. Nice staff. Nothing
Receptionist was the best very nice helpful and funny!
Excellent location, rooms, and amenities. It was quiet and perfect for families.
Great location, beautiful hotel
Love this place. Staff very friendly. Clean. Beautiful grounds.

We absolutely loved our stay at Hotel Roca Negra. The grounds were beautiful, the view out our front door was of the volcano and the staff(Elizabeth and Maria) was pleasant and very helpful with suggestions to enhance our stay. It has a very rural feel with the flora and fauna on property, yet walking distance to restaurants. Of utmost importance, our bed was very comfortable! The value was exceptional. Nothing

We loved this property. Elizabeth and Maria were such a help! The coffee and pancakes at the breakfast place were superb! Good location, We loved everything about this place! There wasn’t anything we disliked about it!

"This small hotel is a gem; the tender loving care is evident, it's impeccably clean, and the host's warm welcome, coupled with a delightful sense of humor, makes it a truly special stay."  "The idyllic atmosphere of the small hotel enhances the overall experience, creating a perfect blend of warmth and charm that lingers in memory."

The grounds are stunningly beautiful! Plants have been selected with wildlife in mind. We spent hours just watching and listening to the birds from the rocking chairs on our front porch. Staff were all friendly and ready to help with anything we needed. Breakfast was delicious. Hotel Roca Negra is a special place! It may be helpful to know that without a car, eating dinners out was a bit of a challenge. There are good restaurants within walking distance, but it gets dark very early, and the main road (with lots of traffic) lacks sidewalks in this part of town.

Lovely pool and hot tub and well maintained games area. Great views of the volcano with a lovely garden, lots of birds. Room was a good size with nice chairs and hammock outside to relax in. Useful to have a fridge in the room but there is no kitchen. The lady on reception was very enthusiastic and willing to help. No storage space to unpack which was not ideal staying for a few nights. You are far out of town so need to drive in but there are good restaurants nearby. There is a tv but it is not a smart tv so is not useful. Breakfast was expensive and not very good.

The room was great, the bed was comfortable and the AC cold.  It was nice to have a mini fridge in our room.  The grounds themselves are so beautiful and lush and the view of Arenal was extra!  We loved that it was close to town, but right off the main road it was convenient to everything.  Yet it still felt private and quiet.  The little kitchen/tea area was great.  We mixed out own drinks and it was nice to have utensils to cut limes and mix drinks etc.  The pool was wonderful and the hot tub was an extra perk we didn't expect to even need or want but it was great to have.  The breakfast was really wonderful as well.  The staff was friendly and accommodating. The wifi was a little slow, it didn't matter too much to us, but if you needed it for work or something that might be tough.

Very big rooms with lovely views and surroundings. Plenty of hummingbirds in all of the surrounding plants! Good location in between the town and hot springs/volcano etc The additional breakfast options were ok, but quite basic.

We loved the location, the staff, the food and the facilities! Everyone was so helpful,  the views were spectacular, and I even got my teenage niece off of her phone and engaging with me in the game room! I really don't have anything bad to say about this place. I do wish they took credit cards.

Bed was huge and comfy and the bathroom was very big. Lovely little terrace overlooking the volcano. The a/c wasn’t too loud/aggressive so was able to sleep with it on, which was rare on our trip! Hot tub and pool were good. Some great restaurants in walking distance. We stayed on our honeymoon, this was one of 8 hotels/Air B&Bs we stayed in on our trip and the only one who made an effort with a token to our honeymoon! It was appreciated. We were going to have breakfast but were put off by lots of dirty tables/plates and disgruntled people waiting. Save your money and have breakfast at the Red Frog Cafe 5 min walk away, same price as the hotel and excellent quality and service!
Breakfast was amazing!  The individual “cabins” were unique.  Love the patio with comfy chairs. Would have liked one additional chair inside.  But pretty close to perfect.
Overall a good stay.Small boutique property.
Beautiful accommodation set into gardens filled with flowers and birds. A restful and comfortable place. Pool, jacuzzi and game rooms add to the appeal. Coffee in the room would be an added bonus
It’s just beautiful….. not far off the road but you feel like you’re in the rain forest.  All staff were just lovely too. That I couldn’t stay longer!
The grounds of this hotel are beautiful - we saw so much wildlife Nothing!  I cant wait to return
The staff and the garden surrounded by wildlife Littlwstorage for clothes in the room.
Lovely view. Nice staff. Good location. Comfortable room. Better facilities in the room.

Cozy unique property with excellent views of the Arenal volcano. Like you are staying in a flower garden combined with a mini farm - and excellent staff. Rooms are very clean and air conditioners work well! No complaints at all - but note that payments are in cash only. Does not accept credit cards.

Stunning setting with gorgeous tropical plants and animals everywhere. Reception was extremely accommodating with everything, including buying discount tickets to Baldi hot springs. Room was clean and comfortable with AC. Felt very private. I loved the hammock. Could walk to a few restaurants but was also close to hot springs. Very good breakfast for $7. Pool was amazing. The walls were a little thin but it didn’t affect us at all.
Humming birds in the garden, volcano view Our room was not cleaned every day, cash only for hotel and restaurant not very convenient, I would prefer to have the option to pay by card
Beautiful property just far enough off the road to feel very private.

Beautiful grounds w wonderful lush plants, toucans, and nice chairs! Breakfast available. Fantastic new renovations! Animals! Local feel! Individual cabanas are large. Bathrooms are large. Could still hear some trucks and noise even at night ( we did use our white noise phone app too).
nothing fancy but great location, friendly staff and comfortable rooms/beds made it a great place to stay. a bit on the pricey side for what you get and we had some issues with wifi at times.

The hotel is set within a beautiful garden. Our room was very large with great beds and linens, and total privacy. There were gorgeous flowers and hummingbirds all around our porch.  There is a great pool and hot tub, and game facilities.  Breakfast is available for $7, which is a huge bargain in the area.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  Security is very good.  The location is superb.  Fabulous value for the cost. Everything was perfect. My only comment is that you can't drive to your unit.  This wasn't a problem for us, as our unit was close to  parking, but it could be for those further away.
Room was great! Great Location and excelent service. Kitchen was under repair so Breakfast was not included!  and You need to pay in cash at the hotel!

The hostesses are very friendly and helpful. The rooms and beds were good and clean. And especially the environment within the resort is absolutely beautiful. There are lots of plants and birds around the room. The air conditioning only worked at the highest airspeed, which was quite noisy during the night

The staff was so personable and friendly! They made sure our stay was perfect, and they were very responsive and flexible. The view of the volcano from our room was amazing. There were a few bugs in the bathroom since the bathroom windows are screened in but they didn’t bother us.
Wonderful location just outside the town. Walking distance to restaurants. Wonderful pool area. Big and spacious rooms. We saw so many birds in the garden!

This property is a birder's paradise! My friend had to work a couple of hours each of the days we were there so I spent that time on the deck with binos, camera and Merlin. The gardens and property are amazing. Close to all the spots we wanted to visit. Unfortunately weather didn't cooperate to see the volcano clearly. coffee maker in room would have been nice.

Very helpful receptionist.
Good location and attractive grounds and gardens. Good views. Nothing to dislike.
Green, Clean and very beautiful new-looking hotel with awesome staff

Nice and green garden. Garden makes your stay private. It was nice and clean. Staff was friendly and helpful.
Superb volcano view when it’s clear. Lovely chicken. Tin roof, very noisy, when raining (it was raining all those days). A bit noisy aircon.  Poor internet while raining.
The grounds are like a botanical garden on steroids- amazingly beautiful- the hummingbirds weee amazing as well Liked everything

The hotel was fantastic; we felt very luxurious staying here. The pool was lovely and often I was the only person using it. The staff were all really helpful and kind. I really enjoyed sitting on the deck in front of our room staring at the volcano. The only issue we had was that wifi was pretty terrible. It was basically impossible to get work done.

The rooms were simple, with nice bathrooms and plenty of space. The property itself is absolutely gorgeous, with all sorts of dense landscaping that gave us a wonderful sense of privacy. The staff were a delight, and were super welcoming after a long drive in. The property is surprisingly quiet and private given that it's on the main road. There are plenty of shops and restaurants in walking distance, and it was easy to drive to all of the major attractions. They were also accommodating for dietary restrictions at breakfast, offering a bit extra of stuff I could eat and omitting things that I couldn't. The wifi was pretty terrible, but I didn't come to Costa Rica to be on the internet. It would have been nice to have a more stable connection for uploading photos, but there were plenty of other options. However, I wouldn't recommend staying here if you needed to get any work done, unless you bring other means of connecting. Additionally, it would have been nice to have an on-menu vegan option for breakfast, but the staff was very accommodating with changes, and it was no problem at all.

Beautiful location, spectacular views and a lovely garden. Room was spacious and well equipped, although a kettle or similar would have been welcome. Staff were lovely and very helpful. Quite a few restaurants and shops nearby or 5 minutes to the main town We didn't realise it was cash only until the day before we arrived. It would have been good to know sooner as it took a while to find ATMs with USD.
The Gardens , the flowers , the staff .
The room was super big and comfortable. The breakfast was very good.
Beautiful views and surrounds. Comfortable bed and great room and balcony. It was 30 mins walk out of La Fortuna town.

Located slightly outside the busy streets of la Fortuna, but still along one of the main travel axes. Nice relaxed place, where we hardly noticed the presence of other tourists. The cabins are secluded behind shrubs and flowers. Ours had its one patio. Pool and jacuzzi are nice and clean. Service at the front desk was excellent and very welcoming.

Friendly staff, as a solo traveller I was made to feel very welcome. Room, although simply furnished was clean and the bed very comfortable, I slept very well (except for when it rained!) I really liked the fridge and being able to store some food and drinks. View of the volcano was an added bonus. Location was excellent - sodas, a supermarket, pharmacy all in walking distance but out enough to feel more rural. Beautiful grounds, great pool area and bonus of the jacuzzi which was perfect after a day full of activities. Coffee and small outdoor kitchen area was good for making sandwiches and breakfast. Excellent value for money overall. Breakfast wasn’t available on the dates I stayed which was unfortunate (the rooms have fridges though so this wasn’t a dealbreaker for me!)
Pool jacuzzi play area rooms have huge showers

We loved the modern spacious bungalow incl. the nice terrace providing views of the Arenal vulcano. The beds were very comfy. Showeres were nice and hot. Wifi was very good in the room as well as in the common areas.
The pool area is lovely and includes a jacuzzi which is turned on (only upon request) as from 3 pm. Breakfast should be included in the price instead of charged extra.

We loved the room and the gardens and view of the volcano were spectacular. We enjoyed the jacuzzi and pool. The breakfast was very good and affordable. The absolute best thing about our stay was the staff. They were so helpful and friendly.
Beautiful garden with hummingbirds and view of Arenal in front of our room, AC We should have stayed longer than one night :-)

We stayed in 4 places in CR and this was our favorite. Beautiful grounds including birds and chickens. Private bungalow with view of Arenal Volcano. Delicious breakfast available for $7...fruit, eggs, rice/beans, toast. Elizabeth, our host, lives on the property was very friendly and accommodating. Great location on edge of La Fortuna....less than half mile walk to restaurants. No suggestions.
This was a gorgeous property, and the staff was very helpful. They did not take credit cards for anything.

Seclusive & secure facility, the staff was super friendly and helpful. We got to see a lot of birds, including parakeets and a variety of hummingbirds. The parking was easy to get in and out of. The breakfast was delicious and very affordable. Water pressure was lower than what we prefer.
This property is an oasis. Loved everything! I did not like that there is not a microwave and coffee maker in the room.

The pool and hot tub were nice for relaxing in the evening. The grounds are a well-maintained garden with weaving paths that made for a relaxing stroll or a nice view from our room's porch or any of the scattered public lounge areas.

Friendly and helpful staff, clean, spacy nice decorated room with big beds. Good shower, lovely terras with rocking chairs and vieuw on the stunning garden and the volcano. A bit of a long wait for breakfast to be served
It was beautiful and the staff was incredible.

Amazing place, great atmosphere and amazing staff. Lovely garden all around, you can just sit on your veranda and watch the flowers, the birds and the volcano. Great breakfast for a very reasonable price!
Beautiful property, friendly staff, great location. Pool and jacuzzi were really pleasant.
Beautiful grounds and cabins and pool. Extremely great and friendly and helpful staff. Restaurants and little store very close for walking.
Absolutely the staff!!

Great staff. Rooms were lovely. Fantastic gardens, seating areas and pool. Lots of birds around as well as the resident birds and dogs. There was confusion with paying for breakfast, it wasn't made clear to us. No coffee in the kitchen area.
Elizabeth was so great! The property and view from the room was just amazing. Loved all of the animals there. Very beautiful and quant place. Highly reccomend!

The staff were very friendly and helpful with recommendations for activities in the area. The room, pool and gardens with views of the volcano were lovely! It was around a 25-30 minute walk from fortuna centre and near lots of restaurants/ shops - the perfect hotel for relaxing and exploring the area!
Beautifully kept, perfect location, extremely friendly and helpful staff with the most relaxing atmosphere. Breakfast the best we had! Nothing
Great hotel, very nice staff! There is a little garden and a great pool area with a jacuzzi! 😍 we enjoyed our 2 nights in the extremely comfortable king size bed and had a sun downer on the veranda.
The privacy of the individual cabins
the extremely queer friendly and welcoming atmosphere. great for couple

The gardens were gorgeous and we enjoyed seeing lots of flowers and birds. The property was gated and felt very secure. We loved the views of the volcano. The breakfast seemed cheap/low quality and not worth paying extra (would have been fine if it was included with our stay). Although the reception staff were friendly and helpful, the staff at the breakfast were not very nice. The room seemed quite clean at first but we noticed there was dirt above the cabinets where the blankets were stored. Also, our suitcases were covered in bugs after we left them on the floor of the room (not sure if the hotel could prevent this issue).

Stunning. My porch was a menagerie of birds and flowers.  I could watch the humming birds for hours. There was thought out into everything. Great attention to detail. Staff promised to assist me with someone at 6:30 am the day I departed but they didn’t show. 

Also, reception has surprisingly poor English. Communication is difficult.  But I just talked slower. They were super kind and helpful most of the time !

Elizabeth and Eugenia at front desk.
Beautiful grounds
Nice outdoor jacuzzi
Great beds
Refrigerator in room
Microwave at reception
Great price
Good location, very pleasant and funny staff. Confortable bed and good air conditioning. Highly recommended
Beautifull place with a nice pool and comfortable rooms.
Very clean and large rooms with private terrace. Wonderful garden. Payment only in cash, breakfast not included and need to be ordered the day before - so no spontaneous option to have breakfast.
Comfortable, modern, clean.  Beautiful grounds and pool, and incredibly welcoming.

The pool and hot tub were great. Breakfast was delicious, quick and homemade. Our room wasn't fancy, but it was clean and secure and had everything we neeeded. It would have been nice to have a coffee maker in the room. And the AC did not get the room quite cool enough for our preference.
Palace is amazing! I feel like I was in expensive resort. Very clean, it was in middle of nature. Host are incredible… Definitely I’ll back here, and tell all my friends to book here. Reference

Hotel Roca Negra was so cozy, we absolutely loved our stay, so much so that we extended our stay by 2 days. There is so much to do aside from all the attractions in La Fortuna, a big beautiful garden with walking paths, a game area with pool and ping pong, a lovely pool and hot tub. Not to mention, all the staff were so friendly and helpful the whole time!

Room was nice.
Breakfast was OK. A bit low on fruits.
There was a pool, a hot tub, billiards table and ping pong table. Breakfast was OK. A bit low on fruits

Beautiful surroundings, generous staff and very nice pool area. Overall I’d say great value for money and I found especially the bathroom much much nicer than based on the pictures. We stayed in a 4-person room. The view is to die for, when El Arenal shows itself. A small suggestion for the breakfast provided on site: if a yoghurt, fruit and cereal option could be included in the choices, that would be great. Breakfast on site was very practical for us and we felt very much looked after by the ladies providing it.

We enjoyed our stay in a cabin at Roca Negra. It was a great location just outside of town but also set back from the road just enough that it felt secluded and peaceful. We spent some quality time on our cabin's porch watching the afternoon rainstorms. The reception staff were very friendly and the breakfast was tasty.
Welcoming staff. Beautiful grounds. Private cabin with amazing view of volcano. Beds were a little squeaky and soft.

Gorgeous well cared for property with excellent view of Arenal. Kind, welcoming, and attentive staff, helped us book other outings. Beds were very comfortable. Our room’s personal hammock was breaking and didn’t work well but the rocking chairs were super comfortable.

The accommodation itself was excellent. We stayed in a very clean and nice bungalow. The garden area is beautiful, and we loved the pool, pool table, table tennis, and small jacuzzi. Having free coffee and tea facilities was a great bonus. The cleaners and landscapers were incredibly kind, friendly, and hard-working. The check-in experience with the management/owner left a very sour taste. After communicating our arrival time, we were met with unnecessary irritation and told to "calm down" simply for politely asking where to park so we wouldn't block the driveway. Furthermore, the management made an intrusive, inappropriate comment to my wife regarding her ethnicity ("Are you from Thailand? You don't look Chinese!"). Throughout the stay, we felt uncomfortable as the management kept staring at us. Excellent property, but the hospitality from management needs a serious lesson in manners and customer service.

The grounds are kept up very beautifully. Its more than a full-time job. The Gallo Pinto (beans and rice) at breakfast are exceptional. The covered deck is perfect.  The birds are so fun to watch and listen to.  We enjoyed having a resident cat who slept on our deck. We can drink from the tap and filled our water bottles. Do walk the grounds!! There's a delightful little nature trail in back I had made my reservations long before my visit and either didn't remember the fine print, or missed it. The hotel only takes cash.  I spent too much time out of my vacation trying to find cash. You can get cash at the ATM only at "Bac San Jose" which actually says, "Bac Credomatic," no "San Jose" anywhere. 
The bathroom and towels never dried & the bathroom floor was really,  really slippery.  (Be careful!) No closet or drawers to put my clothes in. No hot water  from sink.

The bed was very comfortable and the room was spotlessly clean. The rooms were sparsely furnished with very ugly furniture and the lighting would have been perfect for an operating theatre but not so much for a bedroom. It would have been nice to have coffee making facilities in the room. There was a free ‘coffee station’ on the property but the coffee was pretty much undrinkable. The breakfast was ok but not included in the price of the room. Everything in La Fortuna is expensive and this place was no exception.
The bed was comfortable and the room was very clean. The staff were lovely

Very close to every experience La Fortuna has to offer. Walking distance from restaurants. The property itself is lovely with native plants and animals. The pool and hot tub are great. No comforters on the bed, which isn’t a big deal because it’s warm outside. No conditioner for hair, also not a big deal.
The location, jacuzzi, greenery, cleanliness They insist on cash only, but unless the bill looks like it was freshly printed and hand-delivered by the mint, they won’t take it.
Closeness to town, ease of check in

The property is impeccable and incredible. The rooms are clean, well stocked with linens n such. 

The bathrooms are pristine. 

The breakfasts are insanely delicious and satisfying. The main difficulty with the stay is the setup for pymt. it’s like some private business (as seen on my bank statement) where they prefer cash. They didn’t tell me, until I had already flown from USA that they wanted cash pymt. well, I never traveled with cash. I asked them to consider alternative forms of pymt. 
The WiFi was terrible. It went in-n-out and was not reliable. The power went out for a time during a gnarly part of the rainstorm one evening.  
Nothing, including the tv and the fridge was plugged in, like they were trying to save money rather than look luxurious. 
The location was not bad, but you gotta Uber everywhere

Good location. Good parking spot. No hot or warm water in the sink and very limited warm water for the shower. 
Tea coffee making facilities are not in the room. They are in a shared lean too. More like camping. Not at all what we expected. Your wording is very misleading. 
Breakfast is offered by a third party at $6 per person. We didn’t try it. Wanted to but they had nothing to offer a vegan. Again the room looked like camping.

We only stayed for one night, during our stopover at La Fortuna. The hotel is perfectly acceptable. There are a lot of restaurant options in the neighbourhood, the hotel itself does not have a dinner restaurant.
Great location, excellent service from the staff. The plastic pillows.

The staff was very kind and alwsys reafy to help. The location is great. The little Casitas sit amongst beautiful, well-kept grounds. The breakfast needs improvement. Options are small, and the quality is just ok.

The gardens were beautiful with quiet places to relax and lots of birds to watch and enjoy their singing. A safe oasis off a busy road. 
The king size bed was very comfortable and the rooms were clean. We had a nice view of Arenal volcano from our front porch. The building and rooms are getting old and need some TLC. The bathroom sink had no hot water and the roof leaked during a heavy rain. We stepped in puddles around the toilet, brushed our teeth with water dripping on our head and all our toiletries got wet. 
I mentioned the leak to the front desk on check out and they were hesitant to offer any apology claiming it’s an old building and just the way it is. They claimed I should have told them right away but when we came by the desk the first night, no one was there. Same the next morning and at 8pm the following day we were too tired to deal with it and we were leaving. In the end after expressing my displeasure and requesting a discount, they gave us $20 off our 4 night stay.

It is a beautifully landscaped villa park in a green garden, where you can see many birds and encounter a few nice cats.
It's pretty quiet there.
The houses are clean and tidy with a somewhat old-fashioned dated decor.
Most houses have a view of the volcano and some even have very good views.
The breakfast was tasty.
The staff were friendly and welcoming. The air conditioning in our house was loud and could not be adjusted properly.
The decor is quite old-fashioned/dated.
It's annoying that you can't pay with a credit card.
Location.  Friendly staff Smelled mold
The birds and close to soda bar gardens were pretty Thin walls could hear everyone's conversation next door.Dark in the room and looked like the place needed an update.
Nice gardens Small rooms. Little counter space

Friendly staff. Good facilities, with everything you need for a pleasant short stay. It felt safe. Nice quirky property. The room's decor was slightly tacky, with poor use of space. The house next to the reception seemed cluttered and disorganised. The hotel doesn't accept credit/debit cards, only cash. Not really the hotel's fault but there is no sidewalk by the road outside, which makes it a bit dangerous to walk, particularly at night.

Beautiful property - lots of birds 
Great location- walking distance to both downtowns 
Enough parking 
Rooms were clean - water was hot We booked through booking.com- when we got there they forced us to pay in cash with a message the day before. No other place we stayed in asked for cash. 
The front desk took cash from my husband and didnt give the right amount of change back. also with an attitude.

Great location. Close to restaurants, hot springs, and 20 minute drive to Arenal Volcano National park. The hotel also had a really nice view of the volcano. The day prior to the reservation, we were told that we needed to pay for the room fully in cash the day of check-in, even though this is not listed in the policies on booking.com and I reserved with my credit card. We were told if this is inconvenient for us we can cancel which we would have been charged a penalty for canceling on short notice. Upon arrival we paid in all cash for the room. We did not receive a receipt. It seems like they do not have a good way of documenting who paid for the rooms because when I was checking out they asked me to pay for the room again. When I told them I already paid, they said they never wrote it down that I paid so I must have not paid. In addition to the check-in/check-out inconveniences, upon initial entry to our room, there was a giant cockroach in there. We understand the hotel is in a garden and the weather is humid but it made the room feel less clean.

The people were friendly and it the room was clean. You were only able to pay cash! The electricity didn’t work in the morning and they didn’t have generators. We had breakfast included but the kitchen woman was on vacation and wasn’t able to have this!
Can only pay with cash. Don’t understand why Booking is supporting tax evasion.
Lush location at Arenal
The property was very well laid out. Was gated and all the grounds were very clean and well kept. No microwaves in rooms
Mooi aangelegd, uitzicht richting vulkaan geweldig Rupsen met giftige stekeltjes.

Camere pulite e spaziose con patio immerso nella natura. Cucina moderna a disposizione degli ospiti. Molto apprezzata la piscina con l’area relax Il fatto di dover pagare tutto il soggiorno esclusivamente in contanti non fa fare una bella figura
Tout! La piscine, le personnel, le jardin. Chambre spacieuse et belle terrasse Dommage qu’il n’y ait pas un coin cuisine dans le chalet

Traumhafte Unterkunft für unsere Bedürfnisse. Das Personal war sehr freundlich. Kommunikation war reibungslos. Der Garten ist ein Traum. Wir würden jederzeit wieder buchen. Dies war die schönste Unterkunft unserer Rundreise!! Ein wunderschöner Garten mit vielen Vögeln. Wir hätten gar keine Tour mehr gebraucht. Tolle Ausstattung und schönes Bad!

Wunderschöne Anlage mit Bungalows in parkähnlicher Umgebung, schöner Pool, Billiard, Kicker, kleine Küche, alles vorhanden. Wunderschöner Ausblick von der Terrasse auf den Vulkan, grüner üppiger Garten und man kann hier einige Tiere in freier Wildbahn sehen.

De prachtige tuin, het uitzicht op de vulkaan, de ruime lodges. Het mooie zwembad met leuke speelmogelijkheden voor de kids. Zalig ontbijt dat vers wordt bereid. Sehr schönes Haus mit großem Bad, großer Terrasse und viel Platz. Der Garten der Anlage war ebenfalls hübsch, auch wenn die zum Teil sehr künstliche Gestaltung etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig war (u.a. Kunstrasen auf den Wegen). Das Frühstück war gut und der Pool laut den Kids der Beste im gesamten Urlaub. Mehr Möglichkeiten zum Aufhängen nasser Wäsche wäre gut gewesen.

Für uns eins der besten Hotels auf unserer Costa Rica Reise. Die Bilder werden der gepflegten Anlage, dem lustigen und netten Personal und der mega Appartements nicht gerecht. Es ist viel schöner 🥰

Wir haben dort mehrmals zu Abend sowie einmal zum Frühstück gegessen - absolut empfehlenswert.

Ansonsten überhaupt nichts zu bemängeln, wir würden immer wieder kommen 🤙

Zimmer und Badezimmer waren sehr groß, die Terrasse vor dem Zimmer gemütlich, alles gut durchdacht und sehr schön eingerichtet, mit Blick fürs Detail. És un Hotel molt acollidor rodejat de vegetació, amb unes instal•lacions molt ben cuidades. El personal és molt amable.

Alles! Besonders freundliches, hilfsbereites Personal. Tolle Atmosphäre, familiär, gute Lage für Ausflüge, schöner Blick auf den Vulkan, toller Garten! Nichts

Fijne, schone kamers met prachtig uitzicht op de vulkaan. Verblijf met veel oog voor detail bijgehouden. Veel leuke faciliteiten voor de kinderen (pool, tafelvoetbal en -tennis, zwembad). Heel veel tr doen in de omgeving. Wasserette en fijne soda op loopafstand. Eigenlijk niets.
Sehr schönes Hotel in toller Gartenlage mit Blick auf den Vulkan. Hier stimmt fast alles. Nur Schade, dass das Frühstück nicht enthalten ist. Es ist mit 7 Dollar aber recht günstig
Das Frühstück war sehr gut und  für jeden frisch zubereitet.

Le jardin est magnifique. Les colibris que l'on croise tous les jours au milieu des nombreuses fleurs. La vue depuis la terrasse de notre chambre ou depuis le jaccuzi face au volcan Arenal. Le petit coin café et jeux. La gentillesse et l'accueil. Un petit paradis .

Établissement formidable en tous points :
- l’accueil était extraordinaire avec une réceptionniste vraiment très sympathique
- la chambre top au milieu du jardin avec une literie 5 étoiles très confortable et une pergola avec hamac bien appréciable pour profiter de la vue sur le volcan, nous garons notre voiture dans l’enceinte sécurisée à côté de notre chalet
- les espaces communs (jeux, coin thé/cafe, piscine, pergola/salon près de la piscine, jardin très bien entretenu avec un mini semtier de balade et des animaux poules, paon) nous permettent de nous sentir comme à la maison et ont ravi toute la famille
- la localisation est très pratique : près de nombreux magasins de souvenirs, épiceries/supermarchés, sodas/restaurants, thermes populaires. Nous nous sommes baladés à pied et étions très prêts en voiture des principaux centres d’intérêt du coin.

Superbe hôtel très bien situé et au calme. Bungalow spacieux et confortable avec vue sur le volcan. Personnel très accueillant. Grand jardin bien aménagé avec piscine. Le magnifique jardin, bravo les jardiniers! Le petit déjeuner à 7$, bien que bon, n'est pas compris dans le prix de la chambre.

Tolles Preis/Leistungsverhältnis!

Un hotel muy bien cuidado y una atención espectacular, muy recomendable y céntrico, excelente opción que además cuenta con sistema de estacionamiento privado. L'acceuil fort sympathique, et l'emplacement très bien situé. Le fait de ne pas pouvoir payer en carte bleue, dommage !

Das Zimmer war sehr schlicht und nichts besonderes aber die Lage unschlagbar. Versteckt im grünen. Das Hotelgrundstück war voller schöner Pflanzen, Bäume und Tiere. Oase der Ruhe. Großer Bungalow, großer Badebereich, toll. Terrasse inmitten eines wunderbaren Gartens, man sieht hier unzählige Vögel! Personal freundlich, immer ansprechbar. Kaffee/Tee kann man sich zentral zubereiten, gute Idee. Wir waren bereits das 2.Mal in dieser Unterkunft, weil es so schön ist!
Endroit excellent. Petit sentier et aménager pour les oiseaux et papillons.
De tuin en uitzicht. Huisje zag er iets gedateerd uit van binnen.

Petits déjeuners très bons. La connexion wifi à améliorer à l’intérieur du logement.

Heerlijk park, van alle gemakken voorzien: koffiebarretje,  zwembad met ligstoelen,  overdekt pool/biljart/tafeltennis, wandelpaden door het park, alles prima in orde. Keurig ruim huisje in mooi park met fijn terras. Er zaten bloedvlekken op een van de lakens. Maar dat zagen we gelukkig pas toen we weggingen.

Tout était parfait !! Magnifique surtout les jardins et le coin piscine

Hôtel situé dans un magnifique jardin .

Restaurants et magasins à proximité. Rien à dire ...pour nous tout était parfait !
Tout ! La chambre très confortable, la vue sur le volcan, une végétation luxuriante, la piscine et le tout décoré avec beaucoup de goûts. J’ai tellement aimé que je n’ai pas trouvé de point négatif.

De huisjes lagen in een grote tuin vol met exotische planten. Vanuit het huisje zag je de vulkaan. Het huisje, een zitje bij het zwembad, de ontbijtruimte, overal was alles met veel kleur en liefde aan gekleed.
Personeel (zoals Elisabeth) vriendelijk en behulpzaam. 2 km van La Fortuna met veel souvenirshops en restaurants. Grote supermarkt onderweg naar La Fortuna. Veel activiteiten/bezienswaardigheden binnen een half uur.
Welness Tabacon Spa & Hotspring is ongeëvenaard prachtig (forse entree, maar zeker waard). -

Absolument tout! La gentillesse du personnel, la propreté, la sécurité, le confort de la literie, les petits déjeuners exceptionnels, la vegetation luxuriante, les animaux (les colibris juste devant la terrasse!!), les toucans, agoutis, la piscine, le jacuzzi, l'espace jeux, l'emplacement parfait pour faire les excursions, les sodas et restos juste à côté... Nous avons passé une semaine au paradis! Rien à redire, tout était parfait! Pour les adultes comme pour les enfants :-)

Roca Negra ist eine sehr liebevoll angelegte und gepflegte Hotel / Bungalow Anlage. Die ganze Anlage gleicht einem idyllischen Garten mit zahlreichen Pflanzen, Blumen und Bäumen/Palmen. Dazwischen sind die Bungalows.

Das Auto wird neben dem Bungalow geparkt.
Schöner Pool Platz mit geheiztem Jacuzzi.
Das leckere Frühstück wird ab Karte bestellt.

Von unserem Bungalow aus hatten wir freie Sicht auf den Vulkan Arenal. Leider war er bis auf einen kurzen Moment ständig teilweise in Wolken. Geschuldet an den starken Niederschlägen die Tage zuvor, hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit.
Der Bungalow Eingang erfolgt über eine gemütliche Veranda mit 2 tollen Liegestühlen aus Holz.
Schaukelnd konnten wir so den Vulkan sowie verschiedene Vögel in unserem Garten beobachten.
Auch 1 Kolibri drehte wiederholt seine Runden beim Nektar suchen.

Die Hotelmanagerin ist eine sehr aufgestellte Dame mit viel Humor :D
Wir wären am liebsten einige Tage länger geblieben.
Für Ausflüge in der Arenal Gegend liegt das Hotel sehr gut.
Zahlreiche Restaurants können zu Fuss erreicht werden.
Ein Hotel mit feinem Essen ist gerade gegenüber.
Die kleine Stadt ist mit dem Auto in 5min. zu erreichen. 
Das nächste Mal in dieser Gegend, sehr gerne wieder hier im Roca Negra.

Private Unterkunft mit Garten und Hängematte, nicht einsehbar, relativ ruhige Unterkunft und trotzdem gut gelegen, sehr gut gepflegte Anlage, schöner Pool Eingeschränkte Möglichkeiten und Equipment, um sich selbst zu versorgen

Tolle Anlage und sehr freundliches Personal. Zimmer sind sehr großzügig und sauber. Top Empfehlung

Das Hotel glänzt vor allem durch seine Anlage. Der Garten ist wunderschön und es gibt überall tolle Sitzgelegenheiten!

Прекрасное место. Все красиво и хорошо. Я курящий, нельзя курить на территории.

Wunderschönes kleineres und einfaches  Hotel, das alles hat was nötig ist. Die Zimmer haben alle eine schöne Veranda mit Schaukelstühle sowie Amak und der Garten hat viele schönen Blumen und Vögel. Eugenia ist super nett und sehr hilfsbereit. -

La vue sur le volcan depuis la terrasse est magnifique, même si des nuages sont fréquents.

Le jardin est super beau. L'emplacement est pratique, facile d'accès, proche des restaurants et des activités. On peut se garer à côté de la chambre. Il manquait de chaises et une petite table dans la chambre.

Die Lage ist ideal für viele Aktivitäten. Die Unterkunft liegt etwas ausserhalb von La Fortuna, es gibt aber einige Restaurants, alle sind zu Fuss erreichbar. Helaas geen ontbijt tijdens de dagen dat wij er waren.

Wij zaten in een prachtig huisje met fijne bedden en ruime badkamer. Het uitzicht vanaf de veranda op de vulkaan was prachtig. Alle huisjes staan in een grote tuin met mooie planten, bloemen en veel vogels. Föhn is niet heel krachtig… vrouwendingetje ;-)

Wir hatten einen eigenen bungalow der viel Platz bot mit guter Ausstattung. Das Bad war groß und relativ neu. Auf der Terrasse vor dem bungalow konnte man wunderbar den tollen Ausblick auf den vulkan genießen und unzählige Vögel beobachten. Die Außenanlage ist schön gestaltet und der Pool einladend. Es gab zudem eine kleine outdoorküche bei der man den ganzen Tag kostenlos Tee oder kaffe bekam. Wir haben uns hier auch Obst und sandwiches zubereitet. Es war einer der besten Aufenthalte in unserem costa rica Urlaub. Zudem befinden sich einige Restaurants und Bars in der Nähe. War alles super.

Sehr freundliches Personal, kleine Küche für jeden, Kaffee zum selber machen incl.

Wunderschöne Hotelanlage mit tropischem Garten. Dadurch werden viele Kolibris und Vögel angelockt. Frühstück sehr lecker, direkt neben dem schönen Pool darf gegessen werden.
